content.text:
Status: Downloaded newer image for postgres:17-bookworm
docker.io/library/postgres:17-bookworm
=== test PGDG bookworm install ===
INSTALL OK
pgrouting.control
postgis.control

observation.command:
docker pull postgres:17-bookworm 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "=== test PGDG bookworm install ==="; timeout 300 docker run --rm postgres:17-bookworm bash -c '
set -e
apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-17-postgis-3 postgresql-17-pgrouting >/tmp/log 2>&1 && echo "INSTALL OK" || (echo "INSTALL FAILED"; tail -20 /tmp/log)
ls /usr/share/postgresql/17/extension/ | grep -E "postgis.control|pgrouting.control"
' 2>&1 | tail -20
